plugins.name: Neon Kinetic
plugins.description: The original dark neon arena presentation, separated from game logic.

plugins.name: Friendly Tactical
plugins.description: Portrait-first readable style with robot faces, member numbers, health bars, icon-labelled powerups, bright projectile trails, clear moving hazards, safe-zone danger shading, and a match countdown.

plugins.name: Beige Glyph Classic
plugins.description: Minimal beige arena style with circular health-number bots, plain black-bordered walls, clean projectiles, and distinct color-coded powerups.

plugins.name: Beige Glyph Refined
plugins.description: Refined beige portrait style with circular high-contrast health bots, polished impacts and projectiles, plain readable walls, and distinct rotating powerup effects.

plugins.name: Beige Glyph Dark
plugins.description: Refined beige portrait to dark version.

plugins.name: Flying Citadel
plugins.description: Detailed moonlit sci-fi flying-tank presentation with 3D hovercraft, compact floating health HUD chips, luminous rapid-fire projectiles, readable holographic powerups, and industrial citadel walls.
